provenance.primary_source: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA public record 2025; data/programs/conv-2025.json (conventional closed-end, loan_type 1)
provenance.dataset: loan_type=1 (conventional); action_taken in {1,2,3} = decisioned; reverse mortgages excluded; open-end lines of credit excluded; universe U-CONV-2025-DECISIONED (provenance/universe-expansion-2025.md)

attribution.required_text: Source: FinanceRateCalc analysis of the public CFPB HMDA 2025 record (conventional loans); historical aggregate only.

reproduce.api: CFPB/FFIEC HMDA Data Browser API, no key
reproduce.filters: Keep loan_type=1 (conventional), action_taken in (1,2,3) as decisioned, reverse_mortgage != 1; denial = action_taken 3. The API has no reverse-mortgage filter: drop those rows yourself. Also drop open_end_line_of_credit=1 (closed-end universe).
